# Independent project-change values and comparisons

This synthetic public package freezes two independent layers before consumers.
inputs.json and oracle.json define checked parsed change-content, exact items
and field paths. A parsed form may represent a proposal later found ineligible.
semantic-inputs.json and semantic-oracle.json separately define complete
supplied-fact comparison, consequential lineage, defaults, exact fences and
dependency graph/readiness behavior. Parsed answers cannot waive semantic gates.

The [owning pure profile](../../../../../docs/requirements/project-change-values.md)
specifies the bounded comparison interface, complete exact fact projections,
field aliases, default applicability and fixed result stages. Only the chosen
case value is a runtime input; other cases, expected answers and manifest data
never enter the consumer. Comparison facts contain no authority or human-
approval flag. Real canonical lookup/current authority, final target/dependency
CAS, persistence, transport, real provider/human/native/recovery and complete
current/exact readback remain independently required at their consuming gates.

All nine record kinds and create/revise/associate variants are covered. Only
create uses explicit absence. The other operations retain exact expected target
content revision. Complete content and exact candidate identities remain bound.

Within each evidence role, duplicate exact references are refused before sorting
by ASCII organization_id, then observation_id. Roles remain separate. Other
arrays remain ordered, strings remain unchanged, and submitted-command
distinctions belong to their command/fingerprint owner. Normalized evidence
permutations retain content and item identity. Independent canonical literals
use closed ASCII property names, strings, booleans, arrays and objects; no DUT,
validator, maintained canonical generator or consumer output supplied an answer.

The complete canonical preimage, complete encoded item and complete comparison
object each have an inclusive1048576-byte ceiling in their own profiles. This
does not enlarge a command or imply that their Cartesian product fits a wire
envelope or mandatory GET. Per-field and structural capacities still apply.
The comparison oracle distinguishes valid pending DAGs from dependency readiness,
including rejected, contested, stale, missing and foreign conditions.
Comparison size uses compact common-JCS encoding of parsed values, not original
wire bytes. Typed values never coerce booleans into numbers or numbers into text.
The fixture package admits up to512 semantic cases and allows21 nested containers so it can include the deliberately
refused17-depth comparison; the operation's limit remains16. Unused projections
exercise generic value bounds without claiming a selected-field match.

Distinct exact lineage and origin profiles are not universally equal.
Independently supplied complete creation/profile facts distinguish actual
substitution from legitimate different or historical provenance. No blanket
lineage-group deduplication, cross-role evidence disjointness or item/candidate
ID equality is invented.

The data is newly authored synthetic material under the repository's existing
MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms. It contains no real customer data or private checkout,
issue, session or credential metadata. The manifest freezes all literal IDs,
file hashes and owning public inputs. Expected errors and reports contain fixed
typed reasons, not supplied protected content.
